description: This file defines the ShippingQuote class, which models shipping quotation details, including shipping options, fees, and status flags.

classes.name: ShippingQuote
classes.description: Represents a shipping quote with options, fees, and status indicators.

methods.name: setShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: getShippingOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: setShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the shipping module used.

methods.name: getShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Gets the code for the shipping module used.

methods.name: setShippingReturnCode
methods.description: Sets the return code indicating shipping status or errors.

methods.name: getShippingReturnCode
methods.description: Gets the return code indicating shipping status or errors.

methods.name: setFreeShipping
methods.description: Marks whether free shipping is applicable.

methods.name: isFreeShipping
methods.description: Checks if free shipping is enabled.

methods.name: setFreeShippingAmount
methods.description: Sets the threshold amount for free shipping.

methods.name: getFreeShippingAmount
methods.description: Gets the threshold amount for free shipping.

methods.name: setApplyTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Enables or disables applying tax on shipping.

methods.name: isApplyTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Checks if tax should be applied on shipping.

methods.name: getQuoteError
methods.description: Gets the error message, if any, related to the shipping quote.

methods.name: setQuoteError
methods.description: Sets the error message related to the shipping quote.
